description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You command your Colony to swarm an area you choose. Choose a point within long range. The Colony forms a swarm that radiates out to short range in all directions from that point. The area within the swarm is difficult terrain.

Roll Spirit to set the spell's Difficulty. Any time a creature enters or begins its turn within the swarm, it must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, it takes 4d10 damage and checks a Condition. On a pass, half damage and no Condition.

Describe the swarm.
name: Swarm
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: Each time you sustain concentration for this spell, you may shift the area of the swarm 10 ft in any direction you choose.
